name: Nip
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed portrait ability-card artwork for Exploritaire, 63:88 portrait composition. Primary request: Nip: Hero gives a small precise nip to the edge of a dark purple slime, playful controlled mouth contact, compact gentle forward motion.
Input image 1 is Hero identity and approved loose watercolor reference. Hero is a chunky cute tricolor Australian Shepherd, rich charcoal/slate coat, copper/golden orange markings, cream white blaze/muzzle/chest/paws, amber curious eyes and large perky ears. Keep her natural bobtail out of view behind her rump; no flame tail.
Medium: loose hand-dabbed watercolor made from broad irregular wet brush dabs and few large pigment pools. Merged washes, soft wet-on-wet transitions, diluted lost edges, rich pooled dark values, sparse broken expressive indigo ink for face and action. Deliberately simplify fur into masses; no individual hairs, shards, repetitive marks, grain, stippling, glossy digital rendering or dense outlines.
Composition: action fills middle of tall portrait, complete face ears paws within safe margins, readable at small card size. Quiet dark indigo/olive starlit woodland washes behind, no detailed scenery clutter. Leave upper 12% and lower 28% subdued so game's title/cost/description overlays remain legible. Finished original illustration, opaque full-bleed background.
No text, letters, numbers, card borders, UI, logos, watermark, gore or detailed wounds. Blank prop cards only. Match species, proportions, palette and marking placement.
